known_scope_limits: No real-data execution or scientific performance claims
Independent coordinate links are candidate hypotheses
SC donor SD is descriptive spread, not a confidence interval
Patient HC3 inference is descriptive association; current-core candidate selection is exploratory
Current core CLI verification substitutes a deterministic tiny graph/model; no real checkpoint inference was run
Drug attribution uses actual frozen forward passes but explains association strength, not sensitivity direction or pharmacological causality.
ENCODE functional bridges remain RBP depletion evidence; no lncRNA perturbation or external-validation claim.
RBNS sequence scores are predictions; the separate typed relation artifact has not entered a real graph/training run.
C11 current-C three-arm preparation, actual training loader and frozen export are code-implemented and fixture-verified; no real expansion/training/effect comparison was run.
The synthetic comparison uses fixture authority metadata and tiny tensors; it does not attest real patient data, graph quality or scientific accuracy.
C12 audit independently recomputes aggregation with SQL but shares raw-source normalization adapters; it is not biological external validation.

C12 tests exercise actual native producers, audit/query, fusion preparation and public serializers with synthetic files and fixed coefficients only; no optimizer or scientific production analysis was run.
Historical native event artifacts cannot recover discarded context/review fields; obtaining those fields requires rematerializing the upstream events from raw sources.
External isolation is explicitly REGISTERED_MODEL_USE_ONLY; no complete biological-independence attestation or real external performance is claimed.

External source replay uses the same metric implementation; separate analytic tests verify weighted AUROC/AP, tie handling and paired differences. Intervals are exploratory and not multiplicity adjusted.
C14 selected exact/fusion score snapshots, Gene Sets, subtype weighting, coverage, GMT, queries and external consumption are fixture-verified; no real candidate release has been produced.
The selected-analysis 46-case suite verifies this change plus legacy subtype/GeneSet, external and current fusion/rule consumer regressions; cumulative counts are not a full-suite rerun.
Existing G012 validation locks may be consumed; explicit source registration claims no validated winner. Diagnostic fusion status remains unchanged.
Fold stability for final fusion scores is unavailable rather than fabricated. Unknown primary direction cannot enter directional subtypes.
C15 has a bound query/download backend but no completed website/API/frontend integration. No deployment was performed.
Native current V4 full-candidate five-fold inference and source-bound selected analysis consumption are fixture-verified; no actual scientific checkpoint or cohort was inferred.
The current prediction 46-case suite covers native inference, selected analysis and external consumers. Cumulative counts are not one full current-suite run.

Default current prediction verification rechecks source hashes and recomputes the fold ensemble; optional frozen-checkpoint replay reruns all five models. Neither establishes biological external validity.
No bound current Ridge producer exists. Full-candidate predictions supply primary and L1 scores and are not held-out or independent external evaluation.

Native genomic Mutation/CNV, standalone CNV event, directional CNV association and ATAC formats now have actual source/fold aggregation consumers. No real auxiliary source or cohort has been processed.
The 70-case native auxiliary suite also covers the signed single-cell/current rule consumers. Cumulative counts are not a full current-suite rerun.
Native auxiliary replay inspects checkpoints and reconstructs fold aggregation/context/coverage. It does not reproduce omics-derived model forwards or establish biological validation.

CNV event and expression-association proxy outputs remain distinct experts. Historical unbound V1 event manifests are not silently promoted; newly generated event manifests include run/input/partition bindings.

Native State five-fold results now reach native State GeneSets and actual selected-score-weighted member profiles, coverage, GMT and query consumers. No real cohort or current State release was processed.

State aggregation is independently reconstructed from the native OOF table; private-head predictions and raw-measurement statistics are not replayed. Patient consistency is checked within the native input authority; global cross-module patient/use inventory completeness remains C16.

Selected State profiles are descriptive weighted member summaries, not joint GeneSet effects, causal estimates, calibrated pathway probabilities or significance tests; they do not change primary/fusion ranking.

Native Clinical heads, original entity Cox fold results and the current selected analysis now reach actual selected-member support, full endpoint coverage, exact-pathway context and version-bound query/download consumers. No real patient cohort or current Clinical release was processed.

Clinical risk forwards are replayed only for folds with hash-bound native feature artifacts. Older outputs record absent/partial replay explicitly. Raw feature projection and raw entity-patient statistics are not replayed; entity meta-analysis uses the same original statistical implementation.

Clinical member support is a selected-score-weighted descriptive fraction, not a joint GeneSet hazard ratio or p-value. Native one-minus-FDR is explicitly non-posterior. Fold risk distributions keep their native time grids and are not pooled into a calibrated common-horizon risk.
Clinical Excel verification uses project-local openpyxl 3.1.5 and et_xmlfile 2.0.0 on 149, recorded in the suite receipt. Shared environment packages were not modified.

C05 native primary supervision now replays exact checkpoint-authorized validation payloads and masks into current fusion preparation. Missing targets stay null; only eligible targets enter fit/metrics, while prediction retains all candidates. Legacy bare hash-list preparation is explicitly unverified and cannot authorize fitting/current release.

Primary validation labels were already used for checkpoint selection. Fusion pair crossfit is conditional development only: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY_PRIMARY_VALIDATION_REUSED, never independent validation of the entire system. Sealed test labels are not loaded by the native adapter.

An earlier 161-case suite uses frozen synthetic parameters or forbids fitting. No optimizer, real cohort analysis, current trained fusion release or deployment was executed. Cumulative unique case counts describe versioned receipts, not a single full current-suite run.
C01/C08/C13/C15/C16 remain unfinished. C13/C16 still require a complete actual model-use/dependency inventory; C15 requires actual API/frontend integration.

The existing dense and formal streaming drug runners now consume source-bound action, endpoint-specific affinity/potency, real RDKit structure and split-local protocol features. Action/target and potency/target pairings alter the actual frozen-core representation; five serialized private heads and target/pathway deletions consume the same encoder.

Drug pharmacology checks never optimize: actual runner tests stop at the first fitting boundary after inspecting the extended tensors; other tests use frozen synthetic heads. No new trained drug result or real cohort/compound analysis has been produced.

Dose covariates describe native protocol distributions, not dose-conditioned efficacy. Native raw pharmacology extraction/identity integration is now implemented; Measured dose-conditioned signed-response analysis is implemented; C08 still requires current selected/public Drug consumption. The original strength head does not acquire a sensitivity-direction or causal interpretation.
Pharmacology verification uses project-local RDKit 2025.9.3 on 149, recorded in the receipt. Shared environment packages were not modified.

Native DrugCentral target/action/activity and structure adaptation now replays the actual native staging identity authority. Explicit per-assay protocols use the staged source-drug map, retain targetless assays and reject range-as-point substitution. Declared value and relation scales are independently checked; missing or unsupported activity remains unavailable.

The actual encoder binds canonical adapted outputs to their native audit and preserves/rechecks raw files and staged directory trees. Native staging-to-adapter-to-encoder verification uses synthetic inputs only; no real compound/cohort processing, fitting or deployment occurred.

The existing native drug response CLI now consumes source-bound observed point responses, preserving exact dose/exposure/endpoint/unit contexts. Adjacent-dose contrasts pair canonical models within the same dataset; targetless assays, absent pairings, observed zero and missing measurements retain explicit semantics.

Dose analyses use measured data and the existing signed rank-association engine. They are not fitted dose-response curves, strength-head predictions, causal effects or independent validation. Synthetic-only checks execute the actual native staging and analysis entry without optimizers; real biological sources were not run.
case_count_policy: Deduplicate by module and exact parameterized case name; replace the older unparameterized signed-SC runner case with the later five parameterized cases. Only selected passing suites count.
